description: analytical solution of PStar (quadratic equation root) - most complex formula
original_formula: PStar = (fFC*fGOT*Fmax*self%fPV*R**2._rk*vPred + M*fFC*fGOT*R*(Fmax + fGOT*R)*(fFC*(self%kMortFi + vPred)*self%fDRespActFi - self%fPV*vPred*(1._rk + self%fDRespActFi)) - sqrt(max(0.0_rk,fFC**2._rk*fGOT*Fmax**2._rk*R**2._rk*(Fmax*self%fPV*R*vPred*(-self%fPV*vPred + fFC*(self%kMortFi + vPred)) + M*(-self%fPV*(Fmax + fGOT*R)*vPred + fFC*fGOT*R*(self%kMortFi + vPred))*(fFC*(self%kMortFi + vPred)*self%fDRespActFi - self%fPV*vPred*(1._rk + self%fDRespActFi)))))) /(fFC**2._rk*fGOT*R**2._rk*(Fmax*self%fPV*vPred + M*fGOT*(fFC*(self%kMortFi + vPred)*self%fDRespActFi - self%fPV*vPred*(1._rk + self%fDRespActFi))))
code_implementation: PStar = (fFC*fGOT*Fmax*self%fPV*R**2._rk*vPred + M*fFC*fGOT*R*(Fmax + fGOT*R)*(fFC*(self%kMortFi + vPred)*self%fDRespActFi - self%fPV*vPred*(1._rk + self%fDRespActFi)) & - sqrt(max(0.0_rk,fFC**2._rk*fGOT*Fmax**2._rk*R**2._rk*(Fmax*self%fPV*R*vPred*(-self%fPV*vPred + fFC*(self%kMortFi + vPred)) & + M*(-self%fPV*(Fmax + fGOT*R)*vPred + fFC*fGOT*R*(self%kMortFi + vPred))*(fFC*(self%kMortFi + vPred)*self%fDRespActFi - self%fPV*vPred*(1._rk + self%fDRespActFi)))))) & /(fFC**2._rk*fGOT*R**2._rk*(Fmax*self%fPV*vPred + M*fGOT*(fFC*(self%kMortFi + vPred)*self%fDRespActFi - self%fPV*vPred*(1._rk + self%fDRespActFi))))

name: aDSatFiZoo
code_implementation: aDSatFiZoo = ((aFunVegZoo * sum(sDZoo*self%ZOOpref)) * (aFunVegZoo * sum(sDZoo*self%ZOOpref))) / (self%hDZooFi * self%hDZooFi + (aFunVegZoo * sum(sDZoo*self%ZOOpref)) * (aFunVegZoo * sum(sDZoo*self%ZOOpref)))

name: aDSatFiBen
code_implementation: aDSatFiBen = ((aFunVegBent * sum(sDBent*self%BENpref)) * (aFunVegBent * sum(sDBent*self%BENpref))) / (self%hDBentFi * self%hDBentFi + (aFunVegBent * sum(sDBent*self%BENpref)) * (aFunVegBent * sum(sDBent*self%BENpref)))

name: aDSatFiTot
code_implementation: aDSatFiTot = (aDSatFiZoo * fFishZoo + aDSatFiBen * fFishBen + aDSatFiPisc * fFishPisc)

name: tDAssFiZoo
original_formula: tDAssFiZoo = aDSatFiZoo *(kDAssFi * aFunVegAss * uFunTmFish * sDfi - tDEnvFi) * fFishZoo
code_implementation: tDAssFiZoo = aDSatFiZoo * (self%kDAssFi * aFunVegAss * uFunTmFish * sDfi - tDEnvFi) * fFishZoo

name: tDAssFiBen
original_formula: tDAssFiBen = aDSatFiBen *(kDAssFi * aFunVegAss * uFunTmFish * sDfi - tDEnvFi) * fFishBen
code_implementation: tDAssFiBen = aDSatFiBen * (self%kDAssFi * aFunVegAss * uFunTmFish * sDfi - tDEnvFi) * fFishBen

name: tDAssFiPisc
original_formula: tDAssFiPisc = aDSatFiPisc *(kDAssFi * aFunVegAss * uFunTmFish * sDfi - tDEnvFi) * fFishPisc
